verdict.rationale: Ramp explicitly supports creating single-vendor virtual cards with per-vendor spending limits and merchant restrictions (allowed merchants/categories via Funds), directly addressing the shared-credential risk story, and this is corroborated by product docs, API docs (Vault API, spend-controls), and marketing copy describing exactly this use case. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-Ramp) case study or review confirming real-world single-vendor card usage outcomes.
